name: parallax-strip-slider
title: Parallax Strip Slider
description: Fullscreen image slider that reveals each slide through staggered vertical strips with a Ken-Burns zoom and a GSAP SplitText title reveal

props.name: stripCount
props.description: Number of vertical strips the incoming slide is revealed through.

props.name: revealDuration
props.description: Duration of each strip's clip-path wipe, in seconds.

props.name: stripStagger
props.description: Delay between consecutive strips as they wipe in, in seconds.

props.name: zoomFrom
props.description: Starting scale of the incoming image before it settles to 1 (Ken-Burns zoom).

props.name: zoomDuration
props.description: Duration of the image zoom settle, in seconds.

props.name: autoplay
props.description: Auto-advance slides on a 5s timer. Paused while a transition is running and under reduced motion.

props.name: showProgressBar
props.description: Show the thin progress bar across the top of the slider.

props.name: showCounter
props.description: Show the numeric slide counter in the bottom-right.

props.name: showControls
props.description: Enable the click-to-navigate overlay and its circular cursor (left half = previous, right half = next).

props.name: showClue
props.description: Show the hint pill telling the viewer to click either side to navigate.

props.name: accentColor
props.description: Color of the slide title, progress bar fill, caption text, counter, and control borders.
